Baking: 30 minutes|difficulty=1 }} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Meat|Meats]] | [[Cookbook:Pasta|Pasta]] ==Ingredients== * 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] [[Cookbook:Ground Beef|ground beef]], crumbled * 1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] * 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Italian Seasoning|Italian Seasoning]] * 1 pound [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]], such as rigatoni or penne, cooked [[Cookbook:al dente|al dente]] * 32 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounce]] jar or can of your favorite [[Cookbook:Spaghetti Sauce|spaghetti sauce]] * [[Cookbook:Cooking Spray|Cooking spray]] * 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] shredded [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]] ==Procedure== # Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|350°F]]. # Cook beef and onion in a large [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] until meat is lightly browned. Drain and sprinkle with Italian Seasoning. # In a large bowl, combine meat mixture and spaghetti sauce and mix well. Add cooked pasta and mix well. # Spray large [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]] with cooking spray. # Pat meat-pasta mixture level in baking pan. # Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over top. # Cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminium foil]], and [[Cookbook:Bake|bake]] in oven 20 minutes. # Remove foil, and bake uncovered another 10 minutes. ==Notes, tips, and variations== * The baking dish should be large enough to have contents in 1–2 [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] layer. * Don't overcook, or pasta will absorb too much liquid and get soggy.
